python.rollback: No Python mutation is permitted by this scaffold. A future separately reviewed installer must define its own verified uninstall and counted scratch/cache cleanup before enablement.

postgresql.distribution: EDB Windows x86-64 binaries ZIP linked from postgresql.org

integrity.limitation: The EDB binaries page exposes the archive over HTTPS but publishes no archive SHA-256 or detached signature. Content-Length, Last-Modified, and the multipart ETag are metadata, not a cryptographic publisher attestation.

postgresql.rejection: The EDB ZIP has no publisher SHA-256 or detached signature. HTTPS metadata, a locally computed hash, and signatures on a subset of extracted executables cannot attest the full archive.
postgresql.rollback: No Windows PostgreSQL mutation is permitted by this scaffold, so no Windows rollback is currently required.

wsl_fallback.trigger: Required because the EDB portable Windows archive is rejected for runtime.
wsl_fallback.package_integrity_policy: Pin an exact supported PostgreSQL package version and verify distribution-signed repository metadata before installation.
wsl_fallback.storage_policy: Create a dedicated ThriveLens WSL storage location and add it to aggregate accounting before package or cluster bytes are written.
constraints: Do not invoke sudo or change the WSL distribution automatically.
Obtain explicit human authority for WSL system and package changes.
Verify signed package metadata and exact package pins before installation.
Add and validate dedicated attributable WSL storage accounting before package installation or cluster creation.
Run the same loopback, SCRAM, start/stop, memory, and aggregate footprint gates.

compose.purpose: Secondary PostgreSQL-only contract for compatible CI or developer hosts; Docker Desktop is not an R0 dependency.
compose.data_root_policy: The bind source must exactly equal the dedicated data_root, must not be the attributable root, must have a protected allowlisted ACL, and must be empty for initial activation.
compose.directory_acl_policy: Inheritance disabled; no Allow ACE outside the current user, LocalSystem, and BUILTIN Administrators; the current user must have explicit Modify rights.
compose.secret_acl_policy: Inheritance disabled; no Allow ACE outside the current user, LocalSystem, and BUILTIN Administrators; the current user must have explicit effective read access.
compose.engine_storage_accounting_policy: Before activation, the integration owner must add the container engine image, layer, build-cache, and writable-layer storage to aggregate counted paths or run this contract on a disposable CI host with an independently enforced 18 GB cap.
compose.packaging_license: MIT for Docker packaging; contained distribution components retain their own licences

data_inventory_gate.ownership_note: The required inventory update is outside TL-R0-003 owned paths and must be completed by the integration owner before initialization.
